tabs.title: 2. Set an expiry and copy the token

components.text: An Ably account administrator opens Access tokens in the dashboard, creates a token for the intended account, and selects only capabilities needed by the integration. Read-only capabilities are available for apps, rules, queues, keys and statistics. This Control API token is distinct from an app API key.
Create and scope an access token

Choose an expiry period and plan to rotate before it expires. Ably offers 30, 60, 90 days or no expiration and recommends rotation. Copy the token immediately; it is shown only once. Enter it in the protected field. After rotating the token in Ably, replace the saved Ragentic credential from the Credentials page and test the connection again.

Test uses read-only GET /v1/me and checks the returned account ID. The response also contains token capabilities and user/account details, so do not log its body. A successful test proves this token is accepted for /me, not that it has every capability needed for other operations.
